criteria.text: The repair judge runs on a model chosen by replaying real flagged replies, and the choice preserves the rule that the judge is not the model that wrote the reply.
The judge prompt states the criterion the code mechanically enforces, so a correction is no longer discarded for a rule the judge was never given.
The shipped configuration is measured end to end on every flagged reply we hold, and what it adds beyond the free deterministic repair is reported rather than assumed.
